title: EMPERXOR
tagline: Multi dex tool using some of the latest and most stable  DeFi protocols.
description: The project utilizes different protocols to swap assets, trade assets for for arbitrage or to participate in faming to earn yields with blockchain information displayed using Graph. By using this project one can get a comparison of different protocols and see which is a better fit for what they are trying to accomplish or to just experiment in general. The protocol is also to showcase both Layer one and Layer 2.
how_its_made: This project is built using solidity and hardhat along with Javascript/Typescript. This implementation uses the UniswapV3, Kyber, Aave and Compound protocols through the EIP-2535 Diamond Standard by Nick Mudge and on the Layer 2 side, Arbitrum and Skale. Some of the protocols compliment each other and can be used separately.
